name: Weather Reader
description: Real-time weather data and human-friendly summaries — powered by Open-Meteo (no API key required)
author: pila-team

tools.name: get-current-weather
tools.description: Fetch current weather for a location given its latitude and longitude. Returns temperature (°C), wind speed (km/h), and WMO weather code. Pass query parameters: latitude, longitude, and current=temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m,weather_code.

tools.name: summarize-weather
tools.description: Synthesize raw weather data (temperature, wind speed, weather code) into a concise, human-friendly summary. Translate the WMO weather code into plain language (e.g. 0 = clear sky, 61 = slight rain). Include practical advice like whether to bring an umbrella or wear a jacket.
